{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Trax Express''''' was a small [[Starship/Legends|starship]], used for transportation, that was known for its low fares and minimal comfort. It ferried a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents, and the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Hen Jamos]], from [[Draenell's Point]] to [[Entrus]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
